gold: Ipsilateral hemisphere hemorrhagic stroke with peripheral-type facial paralysis

selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of incomplete closure of the right eye, flattening of the right nasolabial fold, and right-sided hemiplegia are consistent with a stroke, and imaging studies show hemorrhage in the left thalamus-radiation crown region and in the lateral ventricle, which supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Intracerebral Hemorrhage
rejected.why: While the patient has intracerebral hemorrhage, it is a subtype of stroke and the symptoms and imaging studies are more consistent with a broader diagnosis of stroke.

rejected.label: Corticobulbar tract lesion
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies do not specifically support a diagnosis of corticobulbar tract lesion, and this diagnosis is less specific than stroke.
